title: What If a Quarter of the World's Wheat Stopped Shipping? 2022

scenes.text: What if over a quarter of the world's wheat exports stopped moving? It nearly happened.
Russia and Ukraine together supply over a quarter of the world's wheat exports, and about a fifth of its maize.
After the 2022 invasion, Ukraine said 30 percent of its farmland was occupied or unsafe.
In March 2022, the UN food price index hit an all-time high, up 12.6 percent in a single month.
Wheat and maize prices each jumped roughly a fifth that month. Vegetable oil leapt 23 percent.
Bread didn't vanish. But one corner of the map had shown it can set the price of a meal worldwide.

description:
